1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One of two attributes; two wide moving mouths and one live lane.
1.natural_language: Discover the cabinet rule through calibration feedback, then start the belt and file every moving specimen into the matching moving drawer mouth. Holding or selecting a filing tab does not stop the belt. A release into the cabinet that misses a mouth, a wrong file, lost specimen or early seal ends the case. Release back onto the belt to cancel safely. Calibration feedback and interrupted or returned uncommitted tabs are safe corrections. The first committed failure ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
